patternsForWebFactory.description: Claims, scientific content and media sections appear after the buybox, not before the CTA.

doNotCopy: review counts, ratings, prices, loyalty points or claims unless verified for Nuvia
checkout behavior without configured commerce operations
recommendedNextTemplateRules: Every ecommerce template should separate PLP and PDP behavior.
Landing pages should preview products but not duplicate the full catalog in multiple sections.
Product cards should be dense enough to sell, but should not invent price, stock, reviews or medical claims.
PDP accordions are mandatory for dermocosmetic products because ingredients and precautions matter.
Search, cart, loyalty and quantity controls should remain disabled or omitted until the client has the operational backend.
